headline: Stonecradle Leads New Flurry as Expanse Quiets
war_summary: The morning wires move the sharpest fighting to Stonecradle, which counts five changes in the last two hours and thirteen on the day about World's End and The Dais, standing four Warden to five Colonial with 5,006 Colonial and 7,166 Warden casualties on the day and both hourly rates accelerating. Mooring County remains close behind with three changes in two hours and fourteen on the day about the Wind Hills and Wiccwalk, now held twelve Warden to none Colonial with 3,667 Colonial and 3,123 Warden losses. The Weathered Expanse, late leader about Frostmarch and Crow's Nest, records none in two hours after three in six and twenty-seven on the day, still four Warden to five Colonial with 13,070 Colonial and 15,519 Warden casualties. Linn Mercy, Stlican Shelf and Fisherman's Row show no changes in six hours despite fifteen, fourteen and thirty-two on the day. Dead Lands, Nevish Line and Callahan's Passage report heavy losses with accelerating rates but no flips.
